name: Pastors Aide
overview: Scripture reveals that pastors are divinely appointed shepherds, entrusted by the Holy Spirit to care for and feed the church with knowledge and understanding, as seen in Jeremiah 3:15 and Acts 20:28. Those who serve alongside pastors, such as pastors' aides, are called to support this sacred ministry by faithfully blessing the Lord and the flock, exemplified by the servants standing in the house of the Lord in Psalms 134:1. The principle of generous giving and faithful service is underscored in Luke 6:38, encouraging those who assist in ministry to do so with a heart of abundance, trusting God’s provision and blessing. Ultimately, all who aid the pastor participate in God's redemptive plan, which promises blessing to those who bless His servants (Genesis 12:3).
